item.title: Almost 1,000 New Internet Addresses Registered In Clare Last Year
item.description: Almost 1,000 new website addresses were registered in Clare last year. The latest domain report from .ie shows there are now 5,401 business sites originating from this county. There were 962 new registrations recorded here last year, marking an annual increase of 18.3%. The greatest increase according to .ie, came from the Construction sector. item.title: Clare Secure First Win Of Football League
item.description: Clare have secured their first win of the Allianz Football League. The Banner beat Fermanagh in a third round division three clash. Lissycasey’s Aaron Griffin and Kilmurry Ibrickane’s Daniel Walsh both found the net for Paul Madden’s charges. A full time result Clare 2-18 Fermanagh 0-18.
